verses.mystical_translation: Refuge is deepest when it strengthens wise living rather than magical invulnerability.
The poem enters through refuge, most high, divine protection, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.

safety_note: Protection language is poetry of trust, not a guarantee of immunity from illness, accident, violence, or death; never blame harmed people for insufficient faith.
